projects.title: Credit Risk Management System
projects.summary: Real-time credit risk evaluation platform combining Spring Boot microservices with Spark batch & streaming jobs on Databricks to score and alert on repayment risk.
projects.impact: Processed 3M+ records/day; improved end-to-end scoring latency and increased pipeline reliability with medallion architecture and automated tests.
notes: Implemented medallion architecture with Delta Lake and incremental ETL.
Automated tests and CI/CD pipelines for multi-environment rollouts.

projects.title: Vehicle Speed Detection (YOLOv7)
projects.summary: OCR and object-detection pipeline to detect vehicle speed and license plates from video streams. Optimized GPU inference and built violation-flagging modules.
projects.impact: Built GPU-accelerated inference pipeline with license-plate OCR and event logging for downstream analytics.
notes: Optimized model inference for GPU; integrated OCR for license-plate extraction.
Produces event logs for downstream analytics and violation reporting.

projects.title: Online Banking Platform
projects.summary: Full-stack online banking application with role-based authentication, secure transaction workflows, and reporting dashboards.
projects.impact: Delivered secure REST APIs, integrated frontend dashboards, and implemented role-based access and transaction audit trails.
notes: Implemented role-based authentication and audit trails.
Integrated frontend dashboards for transaction reporting.

projects.title: Heart Disease Prediction System
projects.summary: Machine-learning system (Jupyter notebook) that trains and evaluates models to predict heart disease — reported accuracy 94.60%. Uses CSV dataset and shows end-to-end notebook-based workflow.
projects.impact: Proof-of-concept ML model with 94.6% accuracy on provided dataset; includes notebook, dataset and output CSVs for reproducibility.
notes: Notebook includes data cleaning, feature engineering, model training, and evaluation.
Contains original dataset and reproducible prediction outputs.

projects.title: HTTP Server Project
projects.summary: Custom HTTP server implementations and supporting scripts (Python) created as a Computer Networks project. Contains server scripts, daemon, and test files.
projects.impact: Implements basic HTTP server functionality, suitable as a teaching/demo artifact for networking concepts; includes server and daemon scripts and project notes.
notes: Repo contains server.py, serverHTTP.py, daemon.py, and a project notes PDF showing iterative development.
Good demonstration of low-level socket programming and HTTP basics.

projects.title: Simon Game
projects.summary: Classic Simon memory game recreated with JavaScript, providing audio-visual pattern playback and user interaction mechanics.
projects.impact: Interactive browser game demonstrating DOM manipulation, event handling, color/audio sequencing, and basic state management.
notes: Implements random pattern generation and step-by-step difficulty escalation.
Good showcase of vanilla JavaScript and game-state logic.
